dict.Aliniere automată: mută și rotește strat: Auto-align: moves and rotates the selected layer so it overlaps the pixel layer below it (the same scene photographed twice by hand); with linked layers 🔗, all of them are aligned to the lowest one
dict.Alinierea automată potrivește stratul al: Auto-align fits the selected layer over a pixel layer below it: put the second photo on a layer above the first one.
dict.Straturile se suprapun deja: n-a fost ni: The layers already overlap: there was nothing to move.
dict.Îmbinare automată: din straturile vizibi: Auto-blend: from the visible layers (or the linked ones 🔗), the same scene photographed with different focus, makes a new layer that is sharp everywhere (align them first with ⧉ Auto)
dict.Îmbinarea automată are nevoie de cel puț: Auto-blend needs at least 2 visible pixel layers (the same scene, sharp in different places).
dict.Îmbinare HDR: din straturile vizibile (s: HDR merge: from the visible layers (or the linked ones 🔗), the same scene photographed brighter and darker, makes a new layer with detail in both the shadows and the highlights (align them first with ⧉ Auto)
dict.Îmbinarea HDR are nevoie de cel puțin 2: HDR merge needs at least 2 visible pixel layers (the same scene, photographed brighter and darker).
dict.Amestecă două canale (din straturi sau d: Blend two channels (from layers or from the whole image) and turn the result into a selection, a saved selection or a new gray layer
dict.Două canale amestecate dau o selecție sa: Two blended channels make a selection or a gray layer (Calculations)
dict.Două canale, fiecare ca imagine gri, se: Two channels, each as a gray image, are blended: source 1 over source 2. The result becomes a selection or a new layer; the image does not change.
dict.Rezultatul e negru peste tot: nu se poat: The result is black everywhere: no selection can be made from it.
dict.Albul din previzualizare se selectează,: White in the preview is selected, black is not, gray is half selected. Click the preview to pick the color there.
dict.Nicio parte a pozei nu se potrivește cu: No part of the image matches the chosen range: increase the tolerance or pick another color.
dict.Selectează după culoare în toată poza, c: Select by color across the whole image, with soft transitions: a picked color, reds, greens, blues…, highlights, shadows or skin tones (Color Range)
dict.Selecție după culoare, lumini, umbre sau: Selection by color, highlights, shadows or skin tones (Color Range)
